title: OR Spawn Eggs
description: Changes Origin Realms capture nets to spawn eggs from 1.21.5
body:
On [Origin Realms](https://originrealms.com/) there's a feature of collecting mobs with disposable Capture Nets. This resourcepack turns all captured mobs into Minecraft 1.21.5 spawn eggs to distinguish these nets by the egg texture. Requires [server pack unlocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/server-pack-unlocker) to put the pack above the server resource pack and the normal work

![Capture Nets Difference](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0f5d3383d6b0f39820a3a2376b8abc64ec42e92.png)

### Featuring 45+ server mobs

![Demonstration of all custom mobs spawn egg textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b94948185a86ecd273d4532bf690ee413c67cada.png)
